create_wigner_data_module: create a WignerDataModule with precomputed coefficients and U blocks for Wigner D matrix computation
precompute_wigner_coefficients: precompute Wigner D coefficients for angular momentum levels lmin to lmax with symmetry optimization
wigner_d_matrix_real: compute Wigner D matrices using real-pair arithmetic from Ra and Rb quaternion components

wigner_d_pair_to_real: transform Wigner D matrix from complex real-pair representation to real spherical harmonic basis
